title: Filtered colimits of etale cohomology
statement:
Let $Y$ be quasi-compact and quasi-separated
[def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let $(F_a)$ be a filtered system of
abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Then

$$
 \varinjlim_a H^q(Y_{\Et},F_a)\xrightarrow{\sim}
 H^q(Y_{\Et},\varinjlim_a F_a)\qquad(q\geq0).
$$

Here cohomology is the derived functor of
[def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]; no torsion assumption is needed. The
assertion also holds in sheaves of modules over a fixed constant ring.

external.place: Etale Cohomology, Lemma Tag 03Q5 (label lemma-colimit), for directed systems; the blueprint's Tag 09Z1 (label lemma-relative-colimit) is the relative version for $R^qf_*$ and colimits of schemes, not this statement

proof.text: Let Gamma be abelian global sections. For any filtered diagram, use the existing module-valued qcqs sections theorem at the terminal identity etale object. To match the value universe use R=ULift Z, then the coefficient equivalence restrictScalars along R equiv Z followed by the equivalence Z-modules to abelian groups. Its induced sheaf equivalence transports the colimit; the section comparison is bijective, hence an isomorphism. Evaluation at the terminal object is naturally Gamma. Thus Gamma preserves the filtered colimit, and Mathlib rightDerivedZeroIsoSelf gives the degree-zero derived case.

Shrink the AB5 universe instances of sheaves and abelian groups to the index universe using Mathlib. Induct on q. The base is the previous step. In the successor step apply the proved generic successor theorem to Gamma, using filtered-injective acyclicity for its acyclicity hypothesis. This proves that every Gamma.rightDerived q preserves the filtered shape.

The source library Gamma.rightDerivedFunctorPlusCompatibility and Gamma.singleFunctorCompRightDerivedFunctorPlusCompHomologyFunctorIso give a natural isomorphism from Etale.cohomology composed with the degree-zero single functor to Gamma.rightDerived q. Transport the colimit cocone along that iso. This gives the abelian statement with its original canonical image cocone.

For module coefficients, prove the underlying sheaf functor is a left adjoint: ModuleCat restriction of scalars along Z to Lambda is left adjoint to coextension; compose with the Z-module-to-abelian equivalence, use the site sheafification adjunction, and identify composeAndSheafify with sheafCompose by the sheafification counit. Hence it preserves the input colimit. Apply the abelian theorem to that diagram. Transport its cocone along the natural module cohomology comparison, then reflect the resulting colimit through the coefficient forgetful functor, which preserves colimits and reflects isomorphisms.

split_report.summary: Rule 0: no sorry-free slopmaster2 declaration states this node. The closest is AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.H_map_isColimit_of_isFiltered (WeilConjectures/AlgebraicGeometry/Curve/Reductions.lean 68-86), which states the abelian clause elementwise for a qcqs scheme, but it is sorry; it is already attached to the citer lemma-weil-pbc-curve-filtered-cohomology. The imported proof argued with hypercovers and hypercover-refinement colimits; it cited Stacks 09Z1, which is the relative version for colimits of schemes. I replaced it by the proof of Stacks 0739 (Cohomology on Sites), applied as in Stacks 073E to the qcqs objects of the small etale site. Stacks 03Q5 states exactly this lemma for directed sets. Its proof says 'special case of 09YQ' and sketches a Cech-to-cohomology induction. 0739 handles filtered categories directly and needs no colimit of schemes, so I used it. Steps: (1) notation, derived functors over an object, functorial injective embeddings; (2) B = qcqs etale objects, Cov = finite coverings inside B, Y in B, fibre products stay in B, cofinality; (3) degree 0; (4) the injective diagram and the exact colimit sequence; (5) Cech vanishing for the colimit of injectives; (6) induction by the long exact sequences and the five lemma; (7) identification of the K-injective cohomology of def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology with R^q Gamma(Y,-), naturally; (8) the module clause via the forgetful functor and 03FD. Statement unchanged. One new node: lem-weil-pbc-grothendieck-functorial-injective-embedding (079H), a Mathlib leaf. The hypercover nodes def-weil-pbc-finite-split-hypercover and thm-weil-pbc-hypercover-cohomology are no longer used.
split_report.blueprint: The blueprint proof has two paragraphs. Paragraph 1 says sections commute with filtered colimits on the basis of qcqs etale objects with finite refinements closed under fibre products. Steps 2 and 3 realize it, with the basis B, the finite coverings Cov and degree 0. Paragraph 2 passes to higher degrees: Cech complexes of the colimit are colimits of Cech complexes, exactness of filtered colimits, the canonical map, and the module version. Steps 4-6 realize it by the dimension shift of Stacks 0739 instead of hypercover refinement; the Cech-complex identity is step 5. Step 7 is the canonical map, step 8 the module version. Not realized: the hypercover route (thm-weil-pbc-hypercover-cohomology) and the citation of Tag 09Z1.
